title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first face using a loop that consists of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0625). The third line starts at (0.75, 0.0625) and ends at (0.0, 0.0625). Finally, the fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0625) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the first face, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0104 units along the normal direction to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Integrate the part by creating a new solid body. The dimensions of the rectangular bar are 0.75 units in length, 0.0625 units in width, and 0.0104 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0104)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
